name: ASMARQ Co.,Ltd.
summary: Asmarq Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company specializing in online market research and recruitment of research participants. Qualitative services include group discussions, online interviews and home visits, while quantitative services include online surveys, central location tests, product home use tests and research samples. It also offers panels and consumer evaluation services such as D STYLE WEB and SHAREVIEW. Dating from 1998, it has its headquarters in Shibuya-ku, Japan.
